# castai_external_connection (Resource)

Manages a cloud-account external connection to CAST AI. A connection represents a customer's cloud account linked to CAST AI with a set of enabled features.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) The cloud provider for this connection. Valid values: AWS, AZURE, GCP, ORACLE.
- `connection_scope` (String) Whether this connection is at account or organization scope. Valid values: AWS_ACCOUNT, AWS_ORGANIZATION, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION, GCP_ORGANIZATION, GCP_PROJECT.
- `enabled_features` (Block List, Min: 1) Features enabled for this connection with their selected sub-features. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--enabled_features))
- `resource_suffix` (String) Suffix for generated cloud resources. Typically obtained from the castai_external_connection_principals resource.
- `scope_key` (String) Unique identifier for the scope (e.g. AWS account ID, GCP project ID, Azure subscription ID).

### Optional

- `metadata` (Block List, Max: 1) Cloud-specific metadata for the connection. Includes the customer-side service accounts, Azure Entra app registrations, and AWS role ARN. Sent after provisioning and establishing trust on the customer side. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID to create/update the connection for. If not provided, will attempt to infer it using the CAST AI API client.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Timestamp when the connection was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `update_time` (String) Timestamp when the connection was last updated.

<a id="nestedblock--enabled_features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enabled_features`

Required:

- `feature` (String) The feature type. Valid values: CLOUD_CONNECT, COST_MONITORING, NODE_AUTOSCALING, WORKLOAD_AUTOSCALING, KARPENTER_ENTERPRISE, STORAGE_OPTIMIZATION, POD_MUTATIONS, APA, DBO, OMNI, KIMCHI.

Optional:

- `registry_version` (String) Registry version to pin for this feature. When set, the connection is stamped with that version's permissions snapshot rather than the latest. When unset, the latest version is used.
- `sub_features` (List of String) Sub-features to include. Empty means base permissions only (no sub-features).


<a id="nestedblock--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Optional:

- `aws` (Block List, Max: 1) AWS-specific metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata--aws))
- `azure` (Block List, Max: 1) Azure-specific metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata--azure))
- `gcp` (Block List, Max: 1) GCP-specific metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata--gcp))

<a id="nestedblock--metadata--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.aws`

Optional:

- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role ARN in the customer's AWS account that Cast assumes.


<a id="nestedblock--metadata--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.azure`

Optional:

- `apps` (Block List) Per-feature Azure Entra app registration details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata--azure--apps))
- `subscription_id` (String) The Azure subscription scoped to this connection.

<a id="nestedblock--metadata--azure--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.azure.apps`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) The client (application) ID of the Entra app registration.
- `feature` (String) Feature ID this app registration belongs to.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID of the Entra app registration.



<a id="nestedblock--metadata--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.gcp`

Optional:

- `service_account_emails` (Map of String) Per-feature customer service account emails the customer created in their GCP project. Keyed by feature ID.
